questions.text:
कम्पनी को हानि से बाहर निकालने के लिए रवि कुमार ने संघर्षरत 'वोवा वॉच कम्पनी' में प्रबंध निदेशक के रूप में जनवरी 2020 में कार्यभार ग्रहण किया । जैसे ही उन्होंने कार्यभार संभाला, उन्होंने कम्पनी द्वारा अच्छा प्रदर्शन न करने का कारण ज्ञात करने की कोशिश की । उन्हें पता चला कि कर्मचारियों को निर्णय लेने में सम्मिलित नहीं किया जाता था तथा उन्हें केवल आदेशों का अनुपालन करना था, परिणामस्वरूप कर्मचारियों का मनोबल कम हो गया ।

परिवर्तन की आवश्यकता को पहचानते हुए रवि कुमार ने कर्मचारियों के उत्साह तथा अभिप्रेरणा को वापस लाने के लिए कार्य आरम्भ किया । उन्होंने खुले वार्तालाप को आरम्भ किया तथा उन्हें निर्णय लेने में सक्रिय रूप से सम्मिलित होने के लिए उत्साहित किया । पुराने डिज़ाइन तथा प्रभावहीन उत्पादन प्रक्रियाओं आदि से संबंधित कम्पनी की चुनौतियों का सामना करने के लिए उन्होंने एक साथ कार्य योजनाएँ तैयार कीं ।

समय व्यतीत होने पर 'वोवा वॉच कम्पनी' एक संघर्षरत कम्पनी से लाभ अर्जित कम्पनी में परिवर्तित हो गई । रवि कुमार की नेतृत्व शैली की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
For taking the company out of losses, Ravi Kumar took over as the Managing Director of the struggling 'Vova Watch Company' in January 2020. As soon as he joined, he tried to find out the reason for the company not doing well. He found that the employees were not involved in decision-making and they had to just follow orders, resulting in low morale of employees.

Recognising the need for change, Ravi Kumar started on a journey to bring back the enthusiasm and motivation of the employees. He initiated open dialogues and encouraged them to actively participate in decision-making. Together, they developed action plans to address the company's challenges regarding outdated designs and inefficient production processes etc.

As time passed, 'Vova Watch Company' transformed from a struggling enterprise to a profit making enterprise. Identify the leadership style of Ravi Kumar :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Democratic leadership style. Ravi Kumar involved employees in decision-making, encouraged open dialogue, and collaborated with them to develop action plans — all hallmarks of democratic leadership. Option (A) Autocratic is incorrect because autocratic leaders make all decisions alone without employee input, which is the opposite of what Ravi did. Option (C) Free-rein is incorrect because that style involves minimal managerial intervention, whereas Ravi actively guided and engaged the team. Option (D) is incorrect since only (B) applies.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) लोकतंत्री नेतृत्व शैली है। रवि कुमार ने कर्मचारियों को निर्णय लेने में शामिल किया, खुले वार्तालाप को प्रोत्साहित किया और उनके साथ मिलकर कार्य योजनाएं बनाईं — ये सभी लोकतंत्री नेतृत्व की विशेषताएं हैं।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक तत्व 'सामाजिक पर्यावरण' का है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is an element of 'Social Environment' ?

options.C: हमारे देश के विदेशों से संबंधों की प्रकृति
options.D: सार्वजनिक तथा निजी क्षेत्र में नियोजित परिव्यय

options_english.C: The nature of relationship of our country with foreign countries
options_english.D: Planned outlay in public and private sectors

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Expectations from the workforce. Social environment refers to the social forces that affect business, including social customs, values, traditions, and workforce expectations such as attitudes toward work, gender roles, and demographic trends. Option (A) Rates of saving and investment belongs to the Economic environment. Option (C) Nature of foreign relationships belongs to the Political/International environment. Option (D) Planned outlay belongs to the Economic environment.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) कार्यबल से अपेक्षाएँ है। सामाजिक पर्यावरण में सामाजिक शक्तियाँ शामिल होती हैं जो व्यवसाय को प्रभावित करती हैं, जैसे कार्यबल से जुड़ी अपेक्षाएँ।

questions.text:
कथन I : अंतरण दूसरे को दायित्व तथा अधिकार देना तथा निष्पादन के लिए उत्तरदेयता का सृजन करना होता है ।

कथन II : अंतरण किए गए अधिकार की सीमा को ध्यान में रखे बिना प्रबंधक का दायित्व अंतरण से पूर्व जैसा ही होगा ।

निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Statement I : Delegation is the entrustment of responsibility and authority to another, and the creation of accountability for performance.

Statement II : Irrespective of the extent of delegated authority, the manager shall still be accountable to the same extent as before delegation.

Choose the correct option from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन II सत्य है तथा कथन I असत्य है ।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement II is true and Statement I is false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Both the Statements are true. Statement I is true because delegation indeed involves entrusting responsibility and authority to a subordinate and creating accountability for performance. Statement II is also true because in delegation, authority is delegated but accountability cannot be delegated — the manager remains accountable to the same extent as before delegation. This is the principle of 'parity of authority and responsibility' combined with the principle that 'accountability cannot be delegated'.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। कथन I सत्य है क्योंकि अंतरण में दायित्व व अधिकार का हस्तांतरण होता है। कथन II भी सत्य है क्योंकि उत्तरदेयता का अंतरण नहीं होता।

questions.text: _____________ का संदर्भ कार्य को सही ढंग से तथा न्यूनतम लागत से करना है ।
questions.text_english: ____________ refers to doing the task correctly and with minimum cost.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Efficiency. Efficiency means doing the task correctly and at minimum cost, i.e., achieving maximum output from minimum input. Option (A) Effectiveness refers to completing the task on time and achieving set goals, regardless of cost. Option (B) Coordination is the process of synchronizing different activities. Option (C) Process is simply a series of steps — it does not specifically refer to minimum-cost performance.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) कुशलता है। कुशलता का अर्थ है कार्य को सही ढंग से और न्यूनतम लागत पर करना।

questions.text: 'डोवेक्स' एक बड़ी कम्पनी है जिसका स्वास्थ्य सेवा उद्योग में एक प्रसिद्ध नाम है, यह जीवन रक्षक दवाओं एवं चिकित्सा उपकरणों के विकास तथा उत्पादन में विशेषज्ञता रखती है । नैतिक व्यवहारों के लिए अत्यधिक प्रतिष्ठा के साथ 'डोवेक्स' ने बड़ी संख्या में निवेशक आकर्षित किए जिनकी कम्पनी के भविष्य में अत्यधिक आस्था थी । इसके परिणामस्वरूप जब भी विस्तार अथवा नई परियोजनाओं के लिए 'डोवेक्स' को बाज़ार से पूँजी एकत्रित करने की आवश्यकता हुई वह यह आसानी से कर पाई । परिणामस्वरूप, यह अंशधारकों को उच्च लाभांश का भुगतान कर सकी । उपर्युक्त में चर्चित लाभांश निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाला कारक जिसके कारण 'डोवेक्स' अंशधारकों को उच्च लाभांश दे पाई है, वह है :
questions.text_english: 'Dovex' was a large company with a renowned name in healthcare industry, specialising in the development and production of life saving medications and medical devices. With a strong reputation for ethical practices, 'Dovex' attracted a large number of investors who had great faith in the company's future. This allowed 'Dovex' to raise capital easily from the market whenever expansion or new projects were to be undertaken. As a result, it could pay high dividends to the shareholders. The factor affecting dividend decision discussed above, which allowed 'Dovex' to pay high dividends to the shareholders is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Access to capital market. Because Dovex had a strong ethical reputation, it attracted a large number of investors and could easily raise capital from the market for expansion. This easy access to capital meant the company did not need to retain large amounts of profits internally, and could therefore afford to pay high dividends. Option (A) Cash flow position relates to the company's ability to pay dividends in cash, which is not the factor highlighted here. Option (B) Stock market reaction influences decisions based on how investors may react to dividend changes, not discussed here. Option (C) Legal constraints restrict the maximum dividends payable, which is also not the factor here.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) पूँजी बाज़ार तक पहुँच है। डोवेक्स की नैतिक प्रतिष्ठा के कारण उसे आसानी से बाज़ार से पूँजी मिल जाती थी, जिससे वह उच्च लाभांश दे सकती थी।

questions.text: "यह एक आजीविका उन्मुख प्रक्रिया है जिसको कर्मचारियों की परिपक्वता तथा संभावित योग्यताओं के वास्तविकीकरण की ओर उन्नति के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है ।" प्रक्रिया की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: "It is a career oriented process designed to help the employees in the progress towards maturity and actualization of their potential capabilities." Identify the process :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Development. Development is a career-oriented, long-term process aimed at helping employees grow towards their full potential and readiness for higher responsibilities. It focuses on the overall growth of an individual and is broader than training. Option (A) Staffing is the function of manning positions in the organisation, not a growth-oriented process. Option (B) Selection is the process of choosing the best candidate from applicants. Option (D) Training is a short-term, skill-specific process focused on a current job, not a career-long developmental journey.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) विकास है। विकास एक दीर्घकालिक आजीविका उन्मुख प्रक्रिया है जो कर्मचारियों की संपूर्ण क्षमताओं को वास्तविक रूप देने के लिए डिज़ाइन की जाती है।

questions.text: 'एस के बिल्डर्स' डिज़ाइनर हाउस खण्ड के बाज़ार अग्रणी बन गए क्योंकि इसने सर्वप्रथम घरों को डिज़ाइन करने के लिए प्रौद्योगिकीय उन्नति के परिवर्तनशील पर्यावरण में कृत्रिम बुद्धि के उपयोग की आवश्यकता का अनुभव किया । यह व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के महत्त्व के निम्नलिखित बिन्दु पर प्रकाश डाल रहा है :
questions.text_english: 'SK Builders' became the market leader in the designer house segment as it was the first to recognize the need of using Artificial Intelligence in designing houses in the changing environment of technological advancement. This highlights the following point of importance of business environment :

options.A: यह ख़तरों की पहचान करने तथा समय से पहले चेतावनी देने में सहायक है ।
options.B: यह फर्म को संभावनाओं/अवसरों की पहचान करने एवं पहल करने के लाभ के योग्य बनाता है ।
options.C: यह उपयोगी संसाधनों का दोहन करने में उपयोगी है ।
options.D: यह निष्पादन सुधार में सहायता करता है ।

options_english.A: It helps to identify threats and early warning signals.
options_english.B: It enables the firm to identify opportunities and getting the first mover advantage.
options_english.C: It helps in tapping useful resources.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) It enables the firm to identify opportunities and getting the first mover advantage. SK Builders was the first company to recognize the opportunity of using AI in house design, which made them the market leader — this is the first mover advantage. Option (A) relates to identifying threats, not opportunities. Option (C) refers to tapping resources, not identifying opportunities. Option (D) refers to performance improvement, which is a broader, indirect benefit, not specifically illustrated here.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। SK बिल्डर्स ने AI के उपयोग के अवसर को सबसे पहले पहचाना और प्रथम प्रवर्तक लाभ प्राप्त किया।

questions.text: _____________बाज़ार में मूल्यों का निर्धारण तथा निर्णयन कम्पनी के प्रबंधन द्वारा किया जाता है ।
questions.text_english: In the ____________ market, prices are determined and decided by the management of the company.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Primary market. In the primary market (also called the new issue market), securities are issued for the first time and the price is determined and set by the company's management. In the secondary market (B), prices are determined by demand and supply forces through market transactions. The money market (C) deals with short-term funds. The stock market (D) refers to where already issued shares are traded, with prices determined by market forces.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) प्राथमिक है। प्राथमिक बाज़ार में मूल्यों का निर्धारण कम्पनी के प्रबंधन द्वारा किया जाता है।

questions.text: एक व्यवसाय की कोष आवश्यकताओं का अनुमान लगाने तथा कोष के स्रोतों को निर्दिष्ट करने की प्रक्रिया कहलाती है :
questions.text_english: The process of estimating fund requirements of a business and specifying the sources of funds is called :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Financial planning. Financial planning is the process of estimating the fund requirements of a business and specifying the sources of funds. It involves deciding how much funds are needed and from where they will be obtained. Option (A) Capital structure refers to the mix of debt and equity in a firm's financing. Option (C) Financial management is a broader concept that includes planning, organising, and controlling financial activities. Option (D) Capital budgeting refers to long-term investment decisions regarding fixed assets.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) वित्तीय नियोजन है। वित्तीय नियोजन में व्यवसाय की कोष आवश्यकताओं का अनुमान लगाया जाता है और कोष के स्रोतों को निर्दिष्ट किया जाता है।

questions.text:
कथन I : एक वित्तीय बाज़ार बचतों को बचत करने वालों से निवेशकों को हस्तांतरित करने में सुविधा प्रदान करता है ।

कथन II : यह बचत करने वालों को विभिन्न निवेशों के विकल्प प्रदान करता है तथा अतिरिक्त कोषों को सर्वोत्तम उत्पादनकारी उपयोग के लिए दिशा देता है ।

निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Statement I : A financial market facilitates the transfer of savings from savers to investors.

Statement II : It gives savers the choice of different investments and helps to channelise surplus funds into the most productive use.

Choose the correct option from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन II सत्य है तथा कथन I असत्य है ।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement II is true and Statement I is false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Both the Statements are true. Statement I is true because a financial market acts as an intermediary that channels savings from those who have surplus funds (savers) to those who need funds (investors), facilitating capital formation. Statement II is also true because financial markets provide savers with a variety of investment options (shares, bonds, mutual funds, etc.) and ensure that surplus funds flow into the most productive uses in the economy, thereby promoting economic growth.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। वित्तीय बाज़ार बचतकर्ताओं से निवेशकों को धन हस्तांतरित करता है और विभिन्न निवेश विकल्प भी प्रदान करता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से शेयर बाज़ार कार्यों से संबंधित ग़लत कथन का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Choose the incorrect statement from the following about functions of a Stock Exchange :

options.A: नई प्रतिभूतियों को तरलता तथा विक्रेयता प्रदान करता है
options.B: लेनदेनों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करता है
options.C: आर्थिक विकास में योगदान देता है
options.D: सट्टे के लिए अवसर प्रदान करता है

options_english.A: Provides liquidity and marketability to new securities

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) because it is the incorrect statement. The Stock Exchange (secondary market) provides liquidity and marketability to already existing (listed) securities, not new securities. New securities are issued and traded in the Primary Market, not the Stock Exchange. Options (B), (C), and (D) are all correct functions of a stock exchange: it ensures safety through regulated transactions, contributes to economic growth by mobilising savings, and does provide a regulated avenue for speculative activities.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है, क्योंकि यह गलत कथन है। शेयर बाज़ार नई प्रतिभूतियों को नहीं, बल्कि पहले से सूचीबद्ध प्रतिभूतियों को तरलता प्रदान करता है। नई प्रतिभूतियाँ प्राथमिक बाज़ार में जारी होती हैं।

questions.text: ऑनलाइन फुटकर विक्रेता 'बिज़न' ई-कॉमर्स के क्षेत्र में विश्व के सबसे बड़े प्रदाता के रूप में आगे बढ़ा है । इसके आगम वर्ष दर वर्ष लगातार बढ़ रहे हैं । यह इसकी सफलता का श्रेय डिजिटाइज़ेशन की तेज़ गति तथा इसकी संगठनात्मक संरचना को देता है । 'बिज़न' का प्रबंध निदेशक, मोहित रणनीतिगत निर्णय लेता है तथा पूरे संगठन पर उसका नियंत्रण है । 'बिज़न' में एक प्रकार की प्रकृति के कार्यों को मानव संसाधन विभाग, विपणन विभाग, क्रय विभाग तथा शोध एवं विकास विभाग के समूहों में एक साथ रखा जाता है । इन विभागों को आगे अनुभागों में बाँटा जाता है तथा सभी विभागीय प्रमुख मोहित को रिपोर्ट करते हैं जो समन्वय प्रमुख हैं । यह मानव संसाधन के उपयोग में कार्यकुशलता सुनिश्चित करता है तथा प्रयासों की पुनरावृत्ति को न्यूनतम करता है । 'बिज़न' के संगठनात्मक ढाँचे का प्रकार है :
questions.text_english: Online retailer 'Bizen' has grown to be the biggest provider worldwide in the field of e-commerce. Its revenues are growing steadily year after year. It owes its success to the rapid rate of digitisation and its organisational structure. 'Bizen's Managing Director, Mohit makes strategic decisions and has control over the entire organisation. In 'Bizen', jobs of similar nature are grouped together into Human Resource Department, Marketing Department, Purchase Department and Research and Development Department. These departments are further divided into sections and all departmental heads report to Mohit who is the co-ordinating head. This ensures efficiency in the utilization of manpower and minimizes duplication of efforts. The type of organizational structure of 'Bizen' is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Functional organisational structure. In 'Bizen', jobs of similar nature are grouped together into departments (HR, Marketing, Purchase, R&D) — this is the defining feature of a functional structure where activities are grouped by function. Option (A) Informal structure has no official basis and arises naturally, which is not the case here. Option (B) Divisional structure groups activities by product, region, or customer type, not by function. Option (D) is incorrect because divisional structure does not apply to Bizen's setup.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) कार्यात्मक संगठनात्मक ढाँचा है। 'बिज़न' में एक ही प्रकृति के कार्यों को एक साथ विभागों में रखा जाता है, जो कार्यात्मक संरचना की विशेषता है।

questions.text:
कॉलम I में दी गई मदों का कॉलम II में दिए गए उनके अर्थों से मिलान कीजिए :

कॉलम I | कॉलम II
1. अनुस्थापन | (i) चयनित कर्मचारियों का अन्य कर्मचारियों से परिचय कराना तथा उन्हें संगठन के नियमों तथा नीतियों से अवगत कराना
2. भर्ती | (ii) इसका संदर्भ कर्मचारी द्वारा उस स्थान अथवा पद को ग्रहण करना है जिसके लिए उसका चयन हुआ है
3. अभिविन्यास | (iii) पूर्व-निर्धारित मानकों से कर्मचारी के वर्तमान तथा/अथवा भूतकाल के निष्पादन का मूल्यांकन करना
4. निष्पादन मूल्यांकन | (iv) संभावित कर्मचारियों को ढूँढने तथा उन्हें संगठन के पदों पर आवेदन करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करने की प्रक्रिया
questions.text_english:
Match the terms given in Column I with their meanings in Column II :

Column I | Column II
1. Placement | (i) Introducing the selected employee to other employees and familiarising him with the rules and policies of the organisation
2. Recruitment | (ii) It refers to the employee occupying the position or post for which he/she has been selected
3. Orientation | (iii) Evaluating an employee's current and/or past performance as against certain predetermined standards
4. Performance Appraisal | (iv) The process of searching for prospective employees and stimulating them to apply for jobs in the organization
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct option from the following :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) 1-(ii), 2-(iv), 3-(i), 4-(iii). Placement (1) means the employee occupying the position for which they were selected — matched with (ii). Recruitment (2) is the process of searching for prospective employees and stimulating them to apply — matched with (iv). Orientation (3) involves introducing selected employees to colleagues and familiarising them with rules and policies — matched with (i). Performance Appraisal (4) involves evaluating current/past performance against predetermined standards — matched with (iii).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। अभिविन्यास = (i), भर्ती = (iv), अनुस्थापन = (ii), निष्पादन मूल्यांकन = (iii)।

questions.text: योजनाएँ एक विशिष्ट कालावधि के लिए तैयार की जाती हैं जैसे कि एक माह, तिमाही या एक वर्ष । इस अवधि के समाप्त होने के पश्चात नई आवश्यकताओं तथा भविष्य की परिस्थितियों के अनुसार नई योजना तैयार करने की आवश्यकता होती है । उपर्युक्त पंक्तियों में संदर्भित नियोजन की विशेषता है :
questions.text_english: Plans are prepared for a specific period of time, may be for a month, a quarter or a year. At the end of that period, there is a need for a new plan to be drawn on the basis of new requirements and future conditions. The feature of planning reflected in the above lines is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Planning is continuous. The passage states that at the end of a plan period a new plan must be drawn — this reflects the continuous nature of planning. Planning never stops; once one plan is completed, a new one begins based on updated conditions. Option (A) Planning is futuristic means it looks ahead, but that is not specifically highlighted here. Option (C) Planning is pervasive means it exists at all levels of management. Option (D) Planning is a mental exercise refers to the intellectual/conceptual nature of planning, which is also not the focus here.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) नियोजन अविरत है। एक योजना समाप्त होने पर नई योजना बनाई जाती है, यही नियोजन की सतत प्रकृति को दर्शाता है।

questions.text: विपणन प्रबंध का वह दर्शन जो उपलब्धता तथा सामर्थ्यता को उद्देश्य प्राप्ति के तरीके के रूप में प्रयोग करता है, है :
questions.text_english: The marketing management philosophy which uses availability and affordability as a means to achieve the objectives is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Production concept. The production concept holds that consumers prefer products that are widely available and affordable. Under this philosophy, businesses focus on producing large quantities at low costs to make goods easily accessible. Option (A) Marketing concept focuses on customer satisfaction. Option (B) Selling concept focuses on aggressive selling and promotion. Option (C) Product concept focuses on quality and features of the product, not on availability and affordability.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) उत्पादन की अवधारणा है। इस अवधारणा में माना जाता है कि उपभोक्ता व्यापक रूप से उपलब्ध और सस्ती वस्तुएं पसंद करते हैं।

questions.text: 'मेहता संस गारमेंट्स' द्वारा अपने विक्रय को बढ़ाने के लिए उपयोग किए गए संवर्धन के तरीके की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Identify the tool of promotion used by 'Mehta Sons Garments' to boost its sales :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Sales promotion. The image shows a banner announcing 50% discount for only 2 days, which is a short-term incentive to boost sales immediately. This is a classic sales promotion technique. Option (A) Advertising is a paid, mass-media communication that is broader and does not specifically involve time-limited discount offers. Option (B) Personal selling involves face-to-face interaction between a salesperson and customer. Option (D) Public relations aims at building goodwill, not driving immediate purchases through discounts.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) विक्रय संवर्धन है। बैनर में 2 दिनों के लिए 50% छूट दी जा रही है जो विक्रय संवर्धन की अल्पकालिक प्रोत्साहन तकनीक है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए : अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) । नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :

अभिकथन (A) : बहुत सी प्रबुद्ध व्यावसायिक फर्मों ने अपने उपभोक्ता सेवा तथा शिकायत केन्द्रों की स्थापना की है ।

कारण (R) : उपभोक्ता को एक वस्तु एवं सेवा से असंतुष्ट होने की स्थिति में शिकायत दर्ज कराने तथा सुनवाई का अधिकार है ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements : Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

Assertion (A) : Many enlightened business firms have set up their own consumer service and grievance cells.

Reason (R) : The consumer has a right to file a complaint and to be heard in case of dissatisfaction with a good or service.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है ।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A). Assertion (A) is true: many enlightened firms do set up consumer service and grievance cells as a part of their consumer protection initiatives. Reason (R) is also true: under the Consumer Protection Act, every consumer has the right to be heard and to file a complaint when dissatisfied. The Reason correctly explains the Assertion — firms set up grievance cells precisely because consumers have a legal right to be heard, and firms wish to proactively address complaints.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण, अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या है। उपभोक्ता के सुनवाई के अधिकार के कारण ही फर्में शिकायत केन्द्र स्थापित करती हैं।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा 'भौतिक वितरण' का एक घटक नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not a component of 'Physical Distribution' ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Standardisation and grading. Standardisation and grading is a function of marketing related to product quality and classification, not a component of physical distribution. The main components of physical distribution are: Inventory control (A), Order processing (C), Transportation (D), and warehousing. Standardisation and grading relates to product decisions, not to the physical movement and storage of goods.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। मानकीकरण तथा ग्रेड तय करना भौतिक वितरण का नहीं, बल्कि उत्पाद निर्णय का हिस्सा है। भौतिक वितरण के घटकों में इंवेंट्री नियंत्रण, आदेश प्रक्रियण और परिवहन शामिल हैं।

questions.text:
बीनू का साबाद में 'बुक-मार्क' नाम से एक बुक स्टोर था । वर्षों तक बुक स्टोर यथोचित अच्छा व्यवसाय कर रहा था परन्तु डिजिटल पुस्तकों तथा ऑनलाइन फुटकर विक्रेताओं के उदय के कारण उसके विक्रय में कमी आ गई । बीनू की बेटी, जिसने हाल ही में विपणन में विशिष्टता के साथ एम.बी.ए. पूरी की है, ने बुक स्टोर के पुनर्जीवन के लिए एक विपणन अभियान शुरू करने का निर्णय लिया । अभियान का केन्द्र-बिन्दु भौतिक रूप में पुस्तक पठन से आनंद प्राप्त करना, पृष्ठों को पलटने का आनंद तथा बुक स्टोर का उष्ण वातावरण था । प्रत्येक सप्ताहांत में उसने कहानी कहना तथा अन्य प्रतियोगिताओं का आयोजन किया । इसकी सूचना अभिभावकों तथा बच्चों को टेलीविज़न, रेडियो, बच्चों की पत्रिकाओं, आदि के माध्यम से दी गई । जीतने वालों को आकर्षक पुरस्कार दिए गए । इससे बच्चों तथा उनके अभिभावकों की बुक स्टोर में आने की संख्या में वृद्धि हुई तथा बहुत जल्द ही बुक स्टोर लोकप्रिय हो गया ।

बीनू की बेटी के द्वारा बुक स्टोर के पुनर्जीवन के लिए उपयोग किया गया संप्रेषण का तरीका था :
questions.text_english:
Beenu had a bookstore in Sabad called 'Book-mark'. For years, the bookstore was doing reasonably well but with the rise of digital books and online retailers, her sales had declined. Beenu's daughter, who had just completed her MBA with a specialisation in marketing decided to launch a marketing campaign to revive the bookstore. The campaign's focus was on the joy of reading books in physical form, the joy of turning pages and the warm atmosphere of the bookstore. She organised story writing and other competitions every weekend. The information of these was given to the parents and children through television, radio, children's magazines, etc. Attractive prizes were offered to the winners. This increased the footfall of the children and their parents and the bookstore soon became popular.

The tool of communication used by Beenu's daughter to revive the bookstore was :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Advertising. Information about the competitions and the bookstore was communicated to parents and children through television, radio, and children's magazines — these are paid, non-personal mass media channels, which is the definition of advertising. Option (B) Personal selling involves direct, face-to-face communication with buyers. Option (C) Sales promotion involves short-term incentives such as discounts or coupons, not media-based campaigns. Option (D) Public relations aims at building a favourable image through unpaid media coverage, not paid mass-media communication.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) विज्ञापन है। टेलीविज़न, रेडियो और पत्रिकाओं के माध्यम से जानकारी देना सशुल्क, व्यक्तिगत-रहित माध्यम है जो विज्ञापन की परिभाषा है।

questions.text:
'बेस्ट इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स' का नेतृत्व इसके स्वप्नदर्शी मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी, निखिल करते हैं । यह गुणवत्ता वाले उत्पादों तथा ग्राहक सेवाओं के लिए प्रतिष्ठित है । निखिल ने ग्राहकों को निरंतर अभिप्रेरित करने तथा उन्हें नवीनतम उत्पाद प्रदान करने की आवश्यकता का अनुभव किया । वह कम्पनी को इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स के क्षेत्र में बाज़ार में अग्रणी बनाना चाहता था ।

निखिल को पता था कि उसकी महत्त्वाकांक्षी परिकल्पना को प्राप्त करने के लिए उसे एक सुस्पष्ट तथा पूर्णतः स्पष्ट योजना की आवश्यकता थी जो कम्पनी के व्यवसाय की विस्तृत रूपरेखा प्रदान करे । उसकी टीम ने उभरती प्रवृत्तियों, ग्राहकों की पसंद तथा संभावित प्रतियोगियों को उजागर करने के लिए विस्तृत बाज़ार सर्वेक्षण किया । इसके आधार पर दीर्घकाल में कम्पनी की दिशा तथा सीमा को परिभाषित करने के लिए एक योजना तैयार की गई । योजना के क्रियान्वयन पर 'बेस्ट इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स' दो वर्षों में ही बाज़ार का नेतृत्व करने लग गई । वह योजना जिसने 'बेस्ट इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स' को बाज़ार में अग्रणी बनने में सहायता की थी, वह है :
questions.text_english:
'Best Electronics' is led by its visionary Chief Executive Officer, Nikhil. It has a reputation for good quality products and customer service. Nikhil recognised the need to continually innovate and provide customers with the latest products. He wanted the company to be the market leader in electronics.

Nikhil knew that to realise his ambitious vision, he needed a clear and well-defined plan that would provide broad contours of the company's business. His team conducted extensive market research to uncover emerging trends, customer preferences, and potential competitors. On its basis, a plan was prepared defining the company's direction and scope in the long run. On the implementation of the plan 'Best Electronics' became the market leader in two years. The type of plan which helped 'Best Electronics' to become the market leader was :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Strategy. A strategy is a comprehensive plan that defines the direction and scope of the organisation in the long run. It involves detailed market research, understanding competitors, and charting the future course of the business. Best Electronics used exactly such a comprehensive long-term plan — a strategy. Option (A) Policy provides general guidelines for decision-making and does not involve detailed market surveys. Option (B) Rule is a specific directive that must be followed. Option (D) Procedure outlines a series of steps to be followed for a routine task.

sub_questions.text_english: State any three features of business environment.

key_points: Dynamic nature — business environment is always changing with changes in technology, consumer preferences, government policies etc.
Complex nature — it is made up of many interrelated forces that are difficult to understand individually.
Multi-faceted nature — a single development can be seen as an opportunity by some and a threat by others.

sub_questions.solution: The business environment has several important features. First, it is dynamic in nature, meaning it is constantly changing due to shifts in technology, government policies, economic conditions, and consumer preferences. Second, it is complex, as it consists of numerous interrelated forces from social, political, legal, economic, and technological dimensions that are difficult to understand in isolation. Third, it is multi-faceted, meaning a single change in the environment may present an opportunity to one firm while posing a threat to another — for example, the rise of e-commerce benefited online retailers but threatened traditional brick-and-mortar stores.

key_points: It involves the withdrawal of a currency unit from circulation by the government.
It aims to curb black money, corruption, counterfeit currency, and terror financing.
It promotes digitisation of the economy and encourages cashless transactions.

sub_questions.solution: Demonetization refers to the act of stripping a currency unit of its status as legal tender. Its key features include: first, it involves the sudden withdrawal of specific currency notes (in India's case, ₹500 and ₹1000 notes in November 2016) from circulation, making them invalid for transactions. Second, its primary aim is to combat black money, corruption, counterfeit currency, and terror financing by forcing undisclosed cash holdings to be declared. Third, it promotes the digitisation of the economy by encouraging people to shift to cashless and digital modes of payment such as NEFT, UPI, and mobile wallets.

अत्यधिक जोखिम तथा बहुत अधिक निवेश के बावजूद, कनव के व्यवसाय के विस्तार की अच्छी संभावनाएँ थी । विश्व स्वच्छ ऊर्जा समाधान की तरफ बढ़ रहा था तथा टिकाऊ पावर स्रोतों की माँग बढ़ रही थी । अत: अनुमानित माँग को जल्दी से पूरा करने के लिए कनव ने उच्च क्षमता का सृजन करने का निर्णय किया । इसके लिए स्थायी परिसम्पत्तियों में और निवेश की आवश्यकता हुई जिसका प्रबंध कनव ने कर लिया ।

questions.text_english:
Kanav, after passing out of college with specialization in renewable energy, was determined to start a solar power plant. The venture required heavy investment in plant and machinery and less on manual labour. Kanav invested in the latest solar panel technology and infrastructure and purchased the latest solar panels, inverters and battery storage systems.

Despite the high risk and substantial investment, Kanav's business had good expansion possibilities. The world was increasingly moving towards clean energy solutions, and there was a growing demand for sustainable power sources. So, Kanav decided to create a higher capacity to meet the anticipated demand quickly. This entailed further investment in fixed assets which Kanav was able to arrange.

As the years passed, the solar power plant did very well and played a pivotal role in the city's transition towards a greener and more sustainable future.

Identify and explain the two factors affecting the fixed capital requirements discussed in the above case.

key_points: Nature of business / Technology used: capital-intensive businesses with heavy plant and machinery require higher fixed capital.
Scale of operations / Growth prospects: a business with high expansion possibilities and decision to create higher capacity requires more fixed capital.

questions.solution: Two factors affecting Kanav's fixed capital requirements are as follows. First, the nature of business and technology used: Kanav's solar power plant required heavy investment in plant and machinery (solar panels, inverters, battery storage) and less on manual labour. Capital-intensive industries that rely on sophisticated technology and machinery require substantially higher fixed capital compared to labour-intensive businesses. Second, growth prospects and scale of operations: since the world was moving towards clean energy and demand was growing, Kanav decided to create higher capacity by investing further in fixed assets. A business with greater expansion possibilities and plans for future growth requires more fixed capital to build the necessary infrastructure and production capacity.

questions.text_english:
A renowned car company named 'BB Motors' was known for producing high performance cars. They were committed to ensure that its employees had the skills and knowledge to build these innovative high-performance cars. To achieve this, they implemented a unique approach for training. The company transformed a section of its factory into what they called the 'Learning Floor'. Actual work environment was created by allotting a specialized space. The space was equipped with a range of car components, tools and sophisticated car equipment identical to those used on the factory floor, where the company's employees would undergo their training.

Identify and explain the method of training used by 'BB Motors' to ensure that its employees had the skills and knowledge to build innovative high-performance cars.

key_points: The method is Vestibule Training.
In vestibule training, a separate area is set up to simulate the actual work environment, equipped with the same tools and equipment used on the actual floor.
It allows employees to learn and practice skills in a controlled environment before working on the actual job.

questions.solution: The training method used by BB Motors is Vestibule Training. In this method, the company sets up a separate area (the 'Learning Floor') that closely replicates the actual work environment. This space is equipped with the same car components, tools, and sophisticated equipment that are used on the actual factory floor. Employees receive training in this simulated environment, which allows them to learn and perfect their skills without the risks and pressures of the actual production floor. This method is particularly suitable for jobs that require the use of specialised machinery and equipment, as trainees get hands-on experience that directly mirrors real work conditions before they are placed on the actual job.

sub_questions.text_english: State any three protective functions of Securities and Exchange Board of India.

key_points: SEBI prohibits fraudulent and unfair trade practices in securities markets.
SEBI prohibits insider trading — using unpublished price sensitive information for personal gain.
SEBI provides education to investors about the securities market.

sub_questions.solution: Three protective functions of SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) are as follows. First, SEBI prohibits fraudulent and unfair trade practices relating to securities markets, such as making misleading statements or manipulating prices, thereby protecting investors from fraud. Second, SEBI prohibits insider trading, which means using unpublished price-sensitive information to trade in securities for personal benefit at the expense of ordinary investors. Third, SEBI undertakes measures to educate investors so that they can make informed investment decisions and are not easily misled by market participants.

sub_questions.text: किन्हीं तीन आधारों पर 'मुद्रा बाज़ार' तथा 'पूँजी बाज़ार' में अन्तर स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Differentiate between 'Money Market' and 'Capital Market' on any three bases.

key_points: Period: Money market deals in short-term funds (maturity up to one year); Capital market deals in long-term funds (maturity more than one year).
Instruments: Money market instruments include Treasury Bills, Call Money, Commercial Paper; Capital market instruments include shares, debentures, bonds.
Participants: Money market participants are RBI, commercial banks, and financial institutions; Capital market participants include retail investors, FIIs, and mutual funds.

sub_questions.solution: Money Market and Capital Market differ on three key bases. First, on the basis of period: the money market deals in short-term funds where instruments have a maturity period of up to one year, while the capital market deals in long-term funds with instruments having a maturity of more than one year. Second, on the basis of instruments: money market instruments include Treasury Bills, Commercial Paper, and Call Money, whereas capital market instruments include equity shares, preference shares, and debentures/bonds. Third, on the basis of participants: the main participants in the money market are the Reserve Bank of India, commercial banks, and financial institutions, while the capital market has a wider range of participants including individual retail investors, foreign institutional investors, and mutual funds.

'वेरफेब' एक पोशाक निर्माणी कम्पनी थी जो अपने उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले फैशनेबल परिधानों के लिए जानी जाती थी । वे पिछले 23 वर्षों से फैशनेबल परिधानों के व्यवसाय में कार्यरत थे । कम्पनी पर्याप्त लाभ अर्जित कर रही थी तथा इसके फैशनेबल परिधानों की माँग अत्यधिक बढ़ रही थी । कम्पनी विस्तार कर रही थी तथा बढ़ती हुई माँग को पूरा करने के लिए इसे नई प्रतिभा को नियुक्त करने की आवश्यकता थी । उन्होंने यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि वे सर्वश्रेष्ठ उम्मीदवारों को नियुक्त करते हैं, एक व्यापक प्रक्रिया का अनुसरण किया ।

प्रक्रिया का आरम्भ आवेदनों के प्रथम चरण के मूल्यांकन से हुआ । मानव संसाधन टीम ने उपलब्ध पदों के लिए सावधानीपूर्वक प्रत्येक उम्मीदवार की योग्यताओं, अनुभव तथा उपयुक्तता की समीक्षा की । इसके द्वारा आवेदन-पत्र में दी गई सूचना के आधार पर रोज़गार चाहने वाले अयोग्य अथवा अनुपयुक्त उम्मीदवारों को निकाल दिया गया तथा 21 ऐसे उम्मीदवारों की संक्षिप्त सूची तैयार की गई जो बुनियादी आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करते थे ।

इसके पश्चात संक्षिप्त सूची वाले उम्मीदवारों को कुछ परीक्षाएँ पास करने के लिए कहा गया जो शारीरिक निपुणता से लेकर बुद्धि या व्यक्तित्व तक कुछ विशेषताओं को मापने का प्रयास करती है । इन परीक्षाओं में उनके सिलाई कौशल, विवरण के प्रति ध्यान, तथा परिधान उत्पादन संबंधी प्रक्रियाओं का आकलन सम्मिलित था ।

क्योंकि इन 10 उम्मीदवारों ने उपर्युक्त सभी चरणों को पूरा कर लिया था,'वेरफेब' ने उम्मीदवारों द्वारा प्रदान किए गए विवरणों की पुष्टि के लिए पूर्व नियोक्ताओं से संपर्क करके उनका सत्यापन किया ।

इसके पश्चात ऐसे 8 उम्मीदवार, जो भूमिकाओं के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त थे, के चयन का निर्णय लिया ।

questions.text_english:
'Verfab' was a garment manufacturing company known for its high quality fashionable clothing. They had been in the fashionable clothing business for the last 23 years. The company was earning enough profit and the demand for their fashionable clothing was rising tremendously. The company was expanding and needed to hire new talent to meet the growing demand. They followed a comprehensive process to ensure that they brought in the best candidates.

The process began with a first-round evaluation of applications. The Human Resources team carefully reviewed each candidate's qualifications, experience and suitability for the available positions. It eliminated unqualified or unfit job seekers based on the information supplied in the application forms and shortlisted 21 candidates who met the basic requirements.

The shortlisted candidates were then asked to take a series of tests that attempted to measure certain characteristics of individuals, ranging from manual dexterity to intelligence to personality. These tests included assessments of their sewing skills, attention to detail, and knowledge of garment manufacturing processes.

15 candidates who performed well in the tests were invited for a formal in-depth conversation with the senior staff from the design team. Thereafter, 10 candidates were found suitable for the job position available.

Since these 10 candidates had cleared all the above steps, 'Verfab' conducted verification by contacting their previous employers to confirm the details the candidates had provided.

Thereafter, a decision was made to choose 8 candidates who were best fitted for the roles.

Explain the steps of the comprehensive process discussed above till the verification stage, to ensure that the company brought in the best candidates to meet the growing demand for fashionable clothing.

key_points: Step 1 — Screening/Preliminary Screening of Applications: The HR team reviewed application forms and eliminated unqualified candidates, shortlisting 21.
Step 2 — Employment Tests: Shortlisted candidates took tests measuring sewing skills, attention to detail, and garment manufacturing knowledge.
Step 3 — Employment Interview: 15 candidates who passed the tests were invited for an in-depth formal interview with senior design staff; 10 were found suitable.
Step 4 — Reference and Background Checks/Verification: Verfab contacted previous employers of the 10 candidates to verify the details provided by them.

questions.solution: The comprehensive selection process followed by Verfab up to the verification stage consisted of four steps. The first step was preliminary screening of applications, where the HR team reviewed each candidate's qualifications, experience, and suitability based on information in their application forms. Unqualified or unfit candidates were eliminated and 21 candidates meeting basic requirements were shortlisted. The second step was employment tests, where the shortlisted 21 candidates were required to take a series of tests measuring characteristics ranging from manual dexterity to intelligence and personality, including assessments of sewing skills, attention to detail, and garment manufacturing knowledge. The third step was the employment interview, where the 15 candidates who performed well in the tests were invited for a formal, in-depth discussion with senior staff from the design team; 10 candidates were found suitable after this stage. The fourth step was reference and background verification, where Verfab contacted the previous employers of the 10 shortlisted candidates to confirm and verify the details they had provided in their applications.

questions.text_english:

sub_questions.text: प्रबंध की किन्हीं चार विशेषताओं का उल्लेख कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: State any four characteristics of management.

key_points: Management is goal-oriented: every managerial activity aims at achieving organisational goals.
Management is all-pervasive: it is required at all levels and in all types of organisations.
Management is multidimensional: it involves management of work, people, and operations.
Management is a continuous process: it is an ongoing and never-ending series of functions.

sub_questions.solution: Four characteristics of management are as follows. First, management is goal-oriented: every activity of management is directed towards the achievement of organisational goals, such as increasing productivity or earning profit. Second, management is all-pervasive: it is required in all organisations — business, non-business, government — and at all levels of the organisation, from top to lower management. Third, management is multidimensional: it encompasses the management of work (what is to be done), management of people (those who do the work), and management of operations (the processes involved). Fourth, management is a continuous process: it is not a one-time activity but an ongoing series of functions — planning, organising, directing, and controlling — that are performed continuously and simultaneously.

sub_questions.text: उच्च स्तरीय प्रबंध द्वारा निष्पादित किए जाने वाले किन्हीं चार कार्यों का उल्लेख कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: State any four functions performed by Top Level Management.

key_points: Setting goals and objectives of the organisation.
Formulating broad policies and strategies for the organisation.
Organising the overall activities and resources of the enterprise.
Appointing senior executives such as departmental managers.

First, they set the overall goals and objectives of the organisation and determine the long-term direction of the business. Second, they formulate broad policies and strategies to guide the entire organisation in achieving its goals, including decisions related to expansion, diversification, and mergers. Third, they organise and coordinate the overall activities and resources of the enterprise, ensuring that different departments work in harmony. Fourth, they appoint key senior executives such as departmental heads and general managers, and are responsible for the welfare of the organisation as a whole and for maintaining relationships with external stakeholders such as government and shareholders.

questions.text_english: Differentiate between 'Delegation' and 'Decentralisation' on any four bases.

key_points: Scope: Delegation is a narrow concept limited to one superior-subordinate relationship; Decentralisation is a broad concept extending throughout the organisation.
Freedom: In delegation, the subordinate has limited freedom to act; In decentralisation, subordinates have greater freedom.
Purpose: Delegation aims to reduce the workload of the superior; Decentralisation aims to empower lower levels and increase organisational efficiency.
Nature: Delegation is a process; Decentralisation is both a philosophy and the result of a consistent policy of delegation.

questions.solution: Delegation and Decentralisation differ on four key bases. First, on scope: delegation is a narrow concept that refers to the entrustment of authority by one superior to one immediate subordinate, whereas decentralisation is a broader concept that extends throughout the entire organisation, involving systematic dispersal of authority at all levels. Second, on freedom to act: in delegation, the subordinate has limited freedom as the superior retains overall control and can revoke authority, whereas in decentralisation, lower-level managers enjoy greater autonomy and freedom to make decisions within their areas. Third, on purpose: the purpose of delegation is to reduce the burden of work on the superior and get tasks done through subordinates, while the purpose of decentralisation is to develop the capacities of lower-level managers and increase overall organisational responsiveness and efficiency. Fourth, on nature: delegation is an inevitable process that every manager must perform to get work done, whereas decentralisation is both a philosophy of management and the end result of a consistent and systematic policy of delegation applied throughout the organisation.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain how the following factors affect the working capital requirement of a business :
(i) Operating efficiency
(ii) Credit availed

key_points: Operating efficiency: higher operating efficiency reduces working capital requirement.
Credit availed: more credit from suppliers reduces the need for working capital.

sub_questions.solution: Operating efficiency refers to how efficiently a business manages its operations. A firm with higher operating efficiency can convert raw materials into finished goods quickly and collect debts faster, which shortens the operating cycle. A shorter operating cycle means less funds are tied up in the cycle at any given time, thereby reducing the working capital requirement. On the other hand, a less efficient firm has a longer operating cycle and therefore needs more working capital. Credit availed refers to the credit extended by suppliers to the business (trade credit). If a business gets longer credit periods from its suppliers, it does not need to pay immediately for purchases, which reduces its immediate cash outflow. This reduces the working capital requirement. Conversely, if suppliers demand quick payment, the business needs to hold more working capital to meet these obligations promptly.

(i) Flexibility

key_points: Flexibility: a company should maintain flexibility to raise additional funds when needed.
Cost of equity: higher cost of equity encourages the use of debt financing.

sub_questions.solution: Flexibility in capital structure means the ability of the company to raise additional funds as and when required. If a company has already used a large amount of debt, its capacity to borrow further is reduced. Therefore, companies try to maintain a capital structure that allows them the flexibility to raise more funds in future, whether debt or equity, without financial strain. This consideration influences a company to not be over-leveraged. Cost of equity is the return expected by equity shareholders. When the cost of equity is high, meaning shareholders expect a high return, it becomes expensive to raise funds through equity. In such cases, a company may prefer to raise debt (which may be cheaper after tax benefits of interest deduction) to minimise the overall cost of capital, thereby opting for a higher proportion of debt in its capital structure.

questions.text_english:
Piyush is the Production Manager of a shoe company 'Comforty'. He has 1000 workers under him in his department. Piyush booked a special order for 300 pairs of gents shoes at an estimated cost price of ₹ 500 per pair plus a 20% profit margin. This order is to be completed within 10 days. After completion of the order, Piyush found out that the production cost of one pair of shoes was ₹ 700. He tried to find out the reason but he couldn't. He reported it to the Chief Executive Officer. For this the Chief Executive Officer appointed Abhay, who was not only a specialized Cost Accountant, but also a qualified Human Resource Manager. After two days, Abhay reported that the set target could have been completed by only 800 workers. This revealed that there was overmanning in the organization. The organization was not utilizing the human resources optimally which had led to high labour cost.

The above case highlights an important function of management.

(i) Identify the function of management discussed above.
(ii) State any three points of importance of the function identified in (i) above.

key_points: The function is Staffing.
Importance: it helps in obtaining right number of people for the right job.
Importance: it ensures efficient performance of other management functions.
Importance: it helps in developing organisational competencies through training.

questions.solution: The function of management highlighted in the case is Staffing. The case reveals that the organisation had 1000 workers but the target could have been achieved by only 800, indicating overmanning — a staffing failure. Proper staffing ensures that the right number of people are placed in the right positions, which Comforty failed to do. Three points of importance of staffing are as follows. First, it ensures optimum utilisation of human resources: proper staffing ensures that there is neither overmanning nor undermanning. In the case of Comforty, overmanning led to increased labour costs and inefficient use of human resources. Second, it contributes to higher performance: when qualified and suitable persons are placed in the right positions, their work efficiency and output are maximised, which directly improves organisational performance. Third, it ensures smooth functioning of the organisation: by maintaining the right number of skilled workers in each department, staffing prevents disruptions and ensures that all functional activities can be carried out without interruption.

Anuj, after a lot of research, paid 'SS Developers' an advance of ₹ 2 crore to build a lavish house for him. They promised to deliver the property within 18 months. At the end of 18 months, Anuj asked for the delivery of the property many times but the developer did not respond. Anuj realized that 'SS Developers' was not in a position to hand over the property to him. Anuj asked for a refund of the money with interest, which 'SS Developers' refused. Anuj approached the consumer court with his complaint.

(i) Which grievance redressal agency had Anuj approached ?
(ii) State any three reliefs Anuj is likely to get, if the consumer court is satisfied with the complaint.

key_points: Anuj approached the State Commission / District Commission — since the amount is ₹ 2 crore, it would be the State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.
Relief 1: Removal of deficiency in service and return of the property.
Relief 2: Refund of the amount paid with interest.
Relief 3: Award of compensation for any loss or injury suffered.

questions.solution: Anuj approached the State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission. Since the value of the transaction is ₹ 2 crore, which exceeds the jurisdiction of the District Commission (up to ₹ 1 crore) but falls within the jurisdiction of the State Commission (above ₹ 1 crore and up to ₹ 10 crore), Anuj's case would be heard by the State Commission. Three reliefs Anuj is likely to get if the consumer court is satisfied with his complaint are: first, he can receive a refund of the entire advance payment of ₹ 2 crore along with interest, since the developer failed to deliver the property as promised. Second, the court can award compensation for the financial loss, mental agony, and inconvenience caused to Anuj due to the developer's failure to deliver. Third, the court can direct the developer to remove the deficiency in service, which could include an order to either complete and deliver the property or pay adequate damages.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following techniques of Scientific Management : (i) Time study, (ii) Differential piece wage system, (iii) Motion study

key_points: Time study: determines the standard time to perform a task.
Differential piece wage system: efficient workers get higher wages per piece, inefficient get lower wages.
Motion study: eliminates unnecessary movements to improve efficiency.

sub_questions.solution: Time Study is a technique used to determine the standard time required to perform a specific task. Using a stopwatch, the time taken by a worker to complete each element of a job is recorded. Based on multiple observations, a standard time is set that becomes the norm for that task. This helps in fixing fair wages, planning workloads, and improving overall efficiency. Differential Piece Wage System is a wage incentive technique introduced by Taylor. Under this system, two different wage rates are fixed — a higher rate for workers who produce at or above the standard output, and a lower rate for those who produce below the standard. This motivates efficient workers by rewarding them more, while creating pressure on inefficient workers to improve their performance. Motion Study involves a careful analysis of the bodily movements made by a worker while performing a job. Unnecessary and wasteful motions are identified and eliminated. Only the most efficient movements are retained in the standardised procedure, reducing fatigue and improving output per worker.

sub_questions.text: प्रबन्ध के सिद्धान्तों की निम्नलिखित विशेषताओं को समझाइए : (i) सामान्य मार्गदर्शन, (ii) मुख्यतः व्यावहारिक, (iii) व्यवहार एवं शोध द्वारा निर्मित
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following features of principles of management : (i) General guidelines, (ii) Mainly behavioural, (iii) Formed by practice and experimentation

key_points: General guidelines: principles provide general direction, not rigid rules.
Mainly behavioural: they are aimed at influencing human behaviour in organisations.
Formed by practice and experimentation: derived from observation and testing in real situations.

sub_questions.solution: General Guidelines means that principles of management do not provide fixed, rigid rules of conduct. Instead, they serve as general guides that help managers deal with practical situations. Since every management situation is unique, principles give direction but allow managers to use their judgement in applying them. Mainly Behavioural means that the principles of management are primarily aimed at influencing and regulating human behaviour in organisations. Management deals with people, and its principles address how individuals can be motivated, coordinated, and directed to achieve organisational goals. They focus on changing how people act and interact within the workplace. Formed by Practice and Experimentation means that principles of management have been developed through years of observation, real-world practice, and scientific experimentation. Thinkers like Taylor and Fayol conducted systematic studies of actual management situations and refined their principles over time. They were not created abstractly but emerged from real managerial experience and tested under different conditions.

questions.solution: This is an OR question. See sub-questions (a) and (b) for model answers.

अतुल शर्मा एक फुटवियर कम्पनी 'स्टेपवन फुटवियर' का मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी था । कम्पनी सभी आयु वर्गों के लिए नवीन तथा आरामदायक फुटवियर का उत्पादन करती थी । अतुल शर्मा सूक्ष्म नियोजन के लिए जाना जाता था । वह यह सुनिश्चित करता था कि कम्पनी के लक्ष्य तथा उद्देश्यों का स्पष्टता से उल्लेख हो ताकि वे क्या कार्य करना है तथा किस दिशा में करना है, के विषय में दिशा-निर्देश दे सके । प्रत्येक मौसम से पूर्व, 'स्टेपवन फुटवियर' बाज़ार प्रवृत्तियों, ग्राहक पसंद तथा उत्पादन कार्यक्रमों का सावधानीपूर्वक विश्लेषण करती है । यह विश्लेषण कम्पनी को आगे देखने, परिवर्तनों का पूर्व अनुमान लगाने तथा, जहाँ आवश्यक हो, प्रबंधकीय प्रतिक्रियाओं का विकास करने के योग्य बनाता है । परिणामस्वरूप, वे बाज़ार को नियमित रूप से नवीन एवं आरामदायक जूतों का वितरण करने योग्य बने रहे ।

एक मौसम में अचानक पर्यावरण-हितैषी जूतों की माँग में उछाल आया । 'स्टेपवन फुटवियर' ने वर्ष के लिए अपने उत्पादन की योजना पहले से ही तैयार कर ली थी ताकि विशिष्ट लक्ष्यों को विशिष्ट समय सीमा में प्राप्त किया जा सके । परिवर्तित परिस्थितियों के अनुसार योजना में परिवर्तन के लिए 'स्टेपवन फुटवियर' के प्रबंधकों के पास लचीलापन नहीं था । जूतों की एक अन्य कम्पनी 'इको स्टेप' ने तुरंत इसे अपनाया तथा आरामदायक पर्यावरण-हितैषी जूतों का उत्पादन आरम्भ किया । शीघ्रता से परिवर्तित हुए बाज़ार के अनुसार समायोजित न होने के कारण, 'स्टेपवन फुटवियर' को इंवेंट्री आधिक्य का सामना करना पड़ा जबकि 'इको स्टेप' टिकाऊ पर्यावरण-हितैषी फुटवियर में एक बाज़ार अग्रणी के रूप में उभरा ।

उपर्युक्त अनुच्छेद से पंक्तियाँ उद्धृत करते हुए, उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित प्रबंध के 'नियोजन' कार्य के दो लाभ तथा दो सीमाओं को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए ।
questions.text_english:
Atul Sharma was the Chief Executive Officer of a footwear company, 'Stepone Footwear'. The company manufactured innovative and comfortable footwear for all age groups. Atul Sharma was known for meticulous planning. He ensured that the goals and objectives of the company are clearly stated so that they act as a guide for deciding what action should be taken and in which direction. Before each season, 'Stepone Footwear' carefully analysed market trends, customer preferences and production schedules. This analysis enabled the company to look ahead and anticipate changes and develop managerial responses, wherever necessary. As a result, they were able to consistently deliver innovative and comfortable shoes to the market.

During one season, there was a sudden surge in demand for eco-friendly shoes. 'Stepone Footwear' had already planned their production for the year with specific goals to be achieved within a specific time frame. The managers of 'Stepone Footwear' did not have the flexibility to change the plan to cope with the changed circumstances. Another shoe company 'Eco Step' quickly adapted and started manufacturing comfortable eco-friendly shoes. By not being able to adjust to the rapidly changing market, 'Stepone Footwear' faced inventory surplus while 'Eco Step' emerged as a market leader in sustainable eco-friendly footwear.

Quoting lines from the above paragraph, identify and explain two benefits and two limitations of 'Planning' function of management discussed in the above case.

key_points: Benefit 1 — Provides direction: goals and objectives act as a guide for deciding what action should be taken and in which direction.
Benefit 2 — Reduces the risk of uncertainty: analysis of market trends enables the company to anticipate changes and develop managerial responses.
Limitation 1 — Planning may not work in dynamic environments: Stepone could not change the plan when the market changed suddenly.
Limitation 2 — Planning leads to rigidity: managers did not have the flexibility to adapt the plan to cope with changed circumstances.

questions.solution: Two benefits of planning identified from the case are as follows. First, planning provides direction: the case states that Atul Sharma ensured that the goals and objectives of the company were clearly stated so that they act as a guide for deciding what action should be taken and in which direction. This shows that planning gives a clear direction to the organisation, helping everyone work towards a common purpose. Second, planning reduces uncertainty: before each season, Stepone analysed market trends, customer preferences, and production schedules, which enabled the company to look ahead, anticipate changes, and develop managerial responses. This demonstrates that planning helps reduce the risks arising from future uncertainties. Two limitations of planning are as follows. First, planning does not work in a dynamic environment: a sudden surge in demand for eco-friendly shoes caught Stepone unprepared. Since the plan was already set, the company could not respond to this new opportunity, ultimately facing inventory surplus. This shows that planning may fail when the environment changes rapidly and unexpectedly. Second, planning leads to rigidity: the managers of Stepone did not have the flexibility to change the plan to cope with the changed circumstances. Once a plan is made, sticking rigidly to it prevents managers from exercising judgement to seize new opportunities, which proved costly for Stepone.

आयूष तथा रिआ टिकाऊ कृषि तथा स्वस्थ रहन-सहन के प्रति भावुक थे । वे जैविक उत्पाद बेचने वाला एक व्यवसाय शुरू करना चाहते थे । उनके पास ग्रामीण क्षेत्र में एक छोटा-सा फार्म था जहाँ उन्होंने ताज़े जैविक उत्पाद तथा जड़ी-बूटियाँ उगाना आरंभ किया ।

शुरू में उन्हें अपने जैविक उत्पादों के विपणन में चुनौतियों का सामना करना पड़ा । उन्होंने अनुभव किया कि एक प्रतियोगी बाज़ार में उपस्थिति बनाए रखने के लिए एक बेहतर प्रस्तुति तथा दृढ़ पहचान की आवश्यकता थी ।

उन्होंने व्यवसाय को 'अर्दी स्टोर' का नाम दिया, जो उत्पादों के लाभों तथा गुणवत्ता की ओर संकेत करता था तथा व्यावसायिक टिकाऊपन के मूल्यों तथा स्वास्थ्य के विषय में प्रतिबिंबित करता था । उन्होंने एक 'लोगो' का चयन किया जिसमें प्रकृति के तत्व सम्मिलित थे तथा उन्होंने अपनी जैविक प्रतिबद्धता दर्शाने के लिए प्राकृतिक रंगों का उपयोग किया । अपने उत्पादों को कूरियर द्वारा ग्राहकों को भेजने के लिए उन्होंने पर्यावरण-हितैषी प्राकृतिक तरीके से जैव-निम्नीकरणीय थैले तथा पुन: प्रयोग योग्य पात्र डिज़ाइन तथा विकसित किए । उन्होंने प्रत्येक थैले में हस्तलिखित टिप्पणियाँ सम्मिलित करके व्यक्तिगत भाव/स्पर्श भी जोड़े ।

उन्होंने प्रत्येक वस्तु के जैविक प्रमाण-पत्र, पोषण लाभों, उत्पादन तिथि, समाप्ति तिथि, आदि से संबंधित विस्तृत जानकारी के लिए भी उत्पाद नाम-पत्र (स्टिकर) डिज़ाइन एवं विकसित किए । उपभोक्ताओं की सुविधा के लिए इस प्रकार विकसित किए गए नाम-पत्रों को थैलों तथा पुन: प्रयोग योग्य पात्रों पर लगा दिया गया ।

संभावित ग्राहकों को अपने उत्पादों के बारे में सूचित करने तथा इन्हें खरीदने के लिए प्रेरित करने के लिए 'अर्दी स्टोर' ने एक उपयोगकर्ता-हितैषी वेबसाइट का सृजन किया एवं मीडिया में प्रबल उपस्थिति स्थापित की । कुछ महीनों में ही उन्होंने एक निष्ठावान ग्राहक आधार का निर्माण कर लिया जिसके कारण प्रतियोगी पर्यावरण में भी वे लाभ कमा पाए । एक वर्ष में ही, वे स्थानीय किराना स्टोर तथा जलपानगृहों से अनुबंध करने में सफल हुए ।

उपर्युक्त अनुच्छेद से पंक्तियाँ उद्धृत करते हुए, उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित विपणन के तीन कार्यों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए ।

Ayush and Rhea were passionate about sustainable agriculture and healthy living. They wanted to start a business selling organic produce. They had a small farm in a rural area where they began growing fresh organic produce and herbs.

In the beginning, they faced challenges in marketing their organic products. They realized that their high quality produce needed better presentation and a strong identity to stand out in a competitive market.

They named the business 'Earthy Store' which indicated the products' benefits and qualities and reflected the values of the business — sustainablility and health. They chose a 'logo' that incorporated elements of nature and used earthy colours to convey their organic commitment. They designed and developed eco-friendly biodegradable bags and reusable containers to courier their products to the customers. They also added personal touch by including handwritten notes in each bag.

They also designed and developed product stickers with detailed information about organic certification, nutritional benefits, date of manufacture, date of expiry, etc. The stickers so developed were put on the bags and reusable containers for customers convenience.

'Earthy Store' created a user-friendly website and established strong media presence to inform potential customers about their products and persuading them to buy the same. Within a couple of months, they had built a loyal customer base which made them earn profits even in a competitive environment. In a year, they were able to secure contracts with local grocery stores and restaurants.

Quoting lines from the above paragraph, identify and explain the three functions of marketing discussed in the above case.

key_points: Branding: naming the business 'Earthy Store' and choosing a logo to create a strong identity.
Packaging and labelling: designing biodegradable bags and product stickers with detailed product information.
Promotion: creating a website and establishing media presence to inform and persuade customers.

questions.solution: Three functions of marketing identified from the case are as follows. First, branding: the case states that they named the business 'Earthy Store' which indicated the products' benefits and qualities and reflected the values of the business — sustainability and health, and they chose a logo that incorporated elements of nature and used earthy colours to convey their organic commitment. Branding involves giving a name, sign, symbol, or a combination thereof to a product to distinguish it from competitors and build customer loyalty. The name 'Earthy Store' and the nature-inspired logo helped create a strong and recognisable identity in a competitive market. Second, packaging and labelling: the case mentions that they designed biodegradable bags and reusable containers for delivery, and developed product stickers with detailed information about organic certification, nutritional benefits, date of manufacture, and expiry. Packaging protects the product and aids in promotion, while labelling provides essential information to customers about the product. Third, promotion: the case states that 'Earthy Store' created a user-friendly website and established strong media presence to inform potential customers about their products and persuade them to buy. Promotion refers to informing, persuading, and reminding customers about the product through various communication tools. The website and media presence served as promotional channels that helped build a loyal customer base.

sub_questions.text_english: Give the meaning of 'Training'. Explain the following methods of training : (i) Apprenticeship Training, (ii) Internship Training

key_points: Training means a process to improve knowledge, skills and attitudes of employees for a specific job.
Apprenticeship Training: theoretical and practical training provided over a long period by skilled craftsmen.
Internship Training: educational institutions and firms collaborate; students work in firms to get practical experience.

sub_questions.solution: Training is a process of learning a sequence of programmed behaviours that improves the employees' knowledge, skills, and attitudes required to perform a specific job. It is a short-term, job-focused process that bridges the gap between what an employee knows and what the job demands. Apprenticeship Training is a method under which the learner is trained both theoretically and practically under the guidance of a skilled or experienced worker, called a master craftsman, for a fixed period. This method is common in trades that require a combination of practical skills and theoretical knowledge, such as plumbing, carpentry, and electrical work. The trainee receives a stipend and gradually becomes fully skilled over time. Internship Training is a joint programme between educational institutions and business organisations. Under this method, students pursuing professional courses (such as engineering, management, or medicine) work in organisations for a specified period as part of their curriculum. Students apply the theoretical knowledge gained in classrooms to real work situations, gaining practical experience that prepares them for professional careers. The organisation benefits by getting fresh talent and ideas, while the student gains hands-on exposure.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four points of importance of 'Directing' function of management.

key_points: Directing initiates action: it converts plans into actual work by guiding employees.
Directing integrates employees' efforts: it coordinates individual efforts towards common organisational goals.
Directing facilitates change: effective directing helps employees adapt to change.
Directing creates stability and balance in the organisation.

sub_questions.solution: Four points of importance of the directing function of management are as follows. First, directing initiates action: while planning, organising, and staffing are preparatory steps, it is directing that actually sets the organisation into motion. By issuing instructions, motivating employees, and providing leadership, directing converts plans into action and ensures work actually begins. Second, directing integrates employees' efforts: every individual in an organisation works with their own personal goals in mind, which may not always align with organisational goals. Directing, through motivation and leadership, integrates the efforts of all individuals and channels them towards the achievement of common organisational objectives. Third, directing facilitates change: organisations must continuously adapt to a changing environment. Effective directing helps overcome employee resistance to change by communicating the need for change, motivating employees to accept new ways of working, and guiding them through the transition smoothly. Fourth, directing ensures stability and balance: a well-managed organisation requires stability in its operations. Through effective supervision and communication, directing ensures that all departments function in a coordinated manner, maintaining balance and preventing conflicts or inefficiencies that could disrupt the organisation.
